questions.q: Visitors are allowed to remain in the lobby ------- the security desk reopens at 8:00 A.M.
questions.why: 後ろに節（S+V）が続くので接続詞が必要で、「〜まで」の意味の until が入る。他は前置詞で節を導けない。

questions.q: The seminar on tax law will take place ------- 2:00 and 4:00 P.M. on Friday.
questions.why: 2つの時刻の「間」を表すのは between 〜 and 〜 の形。among は3者以上の集合に使う。

questions.q: ------- her extensive experience in marketing, Ms. Okabe was named the project leader.
questions.why: 後ろが名詞句なので前置詞句の Because of が入る。Because・Although・In case は節を続ける接続詞。

questions.q: Please submit the expense report ------- Friday at the latest.
questions.why: 「遅くとも〜までに」という期限は by で表す。until は継続する状態の終点に使う。

questions.q: ------- the shipment arrives, please inspect each item for damage.
questions.why: 「届き次第」の意味になる接続詞 As soon as が入る。Whereas は対比、Despite は前置詞で不適切。

questions.q: The warehouse will stay open late this week ------- demand for gift items has increased.
questions.why: 後半が前半の理由になっているので because が入る。although や unless では意味が通らない。

questions.q: The committee has not yet decided ------- to extend the contract with the supplier.
questions.why: decide の目的語として「〜かどうか」を表し、to 不定詞を続けられるのは whether。

questions.q: Visitors are allowed in the laboratory ------- they wear protective glasses.
questions.why: 「〜という条件で」の意味になる provided that が適切。in spite of と owing to は前置詞で節を導けない。

questions.q: The software engineer ------- proposal was accepted will present it at the conference.
questions.why: 直後に名詞 proposal があり「その人の提案」の意味になるので所有格の関係代名詞 whose が入る。

questions.q: Ms. Haddad reviewed the contract, ------- had been revised twice, before signing it.
questions.why: 先行詞は the contract（物）で、後ろに動詞が続くので主格の which が入る。what は先行詞を取らない。

questions.q: Applicants ------- have worked in logistics will be given priority.
questions.why: 先行詞は人で、後ろに動詞 have が続くので主格の who が入る。

questions.q: Not only ------- the new phone offer a longer battery life, but it is also lighter.
questions.why: Not only が文頭に来ると倒置になり、主語が単数なので助動詞 does が前に出る。

questions.q: Rarely ------- such a large number of applications for a single opening.
questions.why: 否定の副詞 Rarely が文頭に出ると、助動詞が主語の前に来る倒置が起こる。

questions.q: The restaurant is known for its ------- service and reasonably priced meals.
questions.why: 名詞 service を修飾する形容詞が必要なので efficient が入る。

questions.q: Ms. Reyes ------- reviewed the budget before presenting it to the board.
questions.why: 過去分詞 reviewed を修飾するので副詞 carefully が入る。

questions.q: The company's ------- to environmental standards has earned it several awards.
questions.why: 所有格 company's の後ろには名詞が必要で、commitment to 〜（〜への取り組み）となる。

questions.q: The new hires are expected ------- the orientation session on Monday.
questions.why: be expected の後ろは to 不定詞が続く。

questions.q: By the time the auditors arrive, the accounting team ------- all the records.
questions.why: By the time の節が現在形で未来を表すので、主節は未来完了形が適切。

questions.q: The number of customers using the mobile app ------- risen steadily since its launch.
questions.why: 主語は The number（単数）で、since があるため現在完了形になる。customers に引きずられないこと。

questions.q: Of the three proposals, the second is by far the ------- expensive to carry out.
questions.why: 3つ以上の中で最も、という最上級なので the most が入る。by far が最上級を強調している。

questions.q: Mr. Tanaka was ------- to the position of regional director last week.
questions.why: 人が役職に昇進する意味では promote の受け身を使う。raise や increase は人の地位には使わない。

questions.q: Because of the storm, the flight was ------- until the next morning.
questions.why: 「〜まで遅れた」の意味になる delay の受け身。prevent や refuse は意味が合わない。

questions.q: The hotel offers a ------- breakfast to all guests staying in a suite.
questions.why: 「無料の」を表す形容詞は complimentary。compliant は「従順な」、competent は「有能な」。

questions.q: Please keep your receipt as ------- of purchase.
questions.why: proof of purchase で「購入証明」という決まった表現になる。

questions.q: Ms. Alvarez is ------- for coordinating all overseas shipments.
questions.why: be responsible for 〜 で「〜を担当している」という意味になる。

questions.q: The contract is ------- for a period of two years and may be renewed.
questions.why: 契約が一定期間「有効である」という意味で valid が入る。vacant は「空いている」。

questions.q: Please ------- the attached form and return it to the personnel office.
questions.why: 書類に「記入する・完成させる」の意味で complete を使う。perform や achieve は目的語が合わない。

questions.q: The architect ------- the plans after the client requested additional windows.
questions.why: 依頼を受けて図面を「修正した」の意味で revised が入る。

questions.q: The ------- of the hotel, near the airport, makes it popular with business travelers.
questions.why: ホテルの「立地」を表すのは location。direction は方角、situation は状況の意味。

questions.q: Staff members are reminded that personal phone calls should be ------- to a minimum during working hours.
questions.why: keep 〜 to a minimum で「〜を最小限に抑える」という決まった表現。
「〜の代わりに」は instead of。他は後ろの of と結びついても意味が通らない。

c: The company cafeteria will be closed on April 1.
Paper forms are still preferred by most managers.
Last year's travel expenses rose by 8 percent.
Training sessions on how to use the portal will be held in the main conference room next week.
questions.why: 新しい申請方法の説明の後、直後の領収書の指示へつながる、ポータルの研修案内が自然。他は文脈に合わないか、内容が矛盾する。
「承認されたら」という流れで、承認後に入金される関係を表す接続詞 Once が適切。
期限の「末日より後に」提出された請求、という意味で after が入る。
改装期間中、図書館が「閉まっている」の意味で closed が入る。
返却箱の場所を示すので、「〜のそばに」の beside が適切。他は場所を表さない。

c: You may still reserve books online during the closure.
The library was founded more than 80 years ago.
The renovation will be completed by the end of May.
All meeting rooms are available at no charge.
questions.why: 休館中も予約できるという内容の後に、「受け取りサービスも提供する」と続く流れが自然。工事の完了時期は冒頭の日付と矛盾する。
主語 We の後ろに動詞が必要なので appreciate が入る。
助動詞 will の後ろは動詞の原形になる。

c: Ms. Brenner has no plans to retire.
The Riverside district is on the opposite side of the country.
Fresh flour is delivered every morning from a northern mill.
The original store, which opened five years ago, will continue to operate as usual.
questions.why: 2号店の話の中で、1号店の営業継続に触れる文が自然につながる。他は話題と無関係か、本文と矛盾する。
人数を受けて「そのうちの大半」と続くので most of whom の形になる。他の語は of whom の前に置けない。
「多くの支援を受けた、だから恩返ししたい」という結果の関係を表す so が入る。
stop doing で「〜するのをやめる」、stopped working で「動かなくなった」の意味になる。
unit を修飾する名詞を前に置く複合名詞 replacement unit（交換品）が適切。

c: Your original unit must be returned within fourteen days of receiving the new one.
Lumen Home Appliances has been in business for forty years.
A refund will be issued to your credit card today.
The warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse.
questions.why: 交換品を送るという内容の後に、不良品の返送条件を述べる文が続き、次の梱包の指示とつながる。他は文脈と矛盾するか無関係。
「何か質問があれば返信を」という条件を表す If が入る。

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Walsh report?
c: A client has canceled a luncheon.
A delivery van was damaged on the road.
A food order will arrive later than needed.
questions.why: ケータリング業者から、昼食会に間に合わない時間になるという連絡があったことが問題点である。

questions.q: At 10:07 A.M., what does Mr. Boyd most likely mean when he writes, "I'd rather not risk it"?
c: He is unwilling to pay a discounted price.
He is worried about the safety of the van.
He wants to postpone the luncheon.
He does not want to depend on a late delivery.
questions.why: 割引や追加サービスを提示されても、遅れる業者に任せたくないという意図である。

questions.q: What will Mr. Boyd do next?
c: Tell the caterer that the order is canceled.
Place an order with Dolores Cafe.
Ask for a free dessert tray.
Call the guests to change the time.
questions.why: 注文を出すのは Walsh さんで、Boyd さんは業者にキャンセルを伝えると述べている。

questions.q: Who can receive an additional discount?
c: Anyone who buys a rain jacket
Trail Club members shopping on November 21
questions.why: 追加の10%引きは、Trail Club の会員が11月21日に購入する場合に限られる。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as part of the sale?
c: A free gift for large purchases
A reduced price on rain jackets
questions.why: オンライン注文の送料無料には触れられていない。他は本文に書かれている。

questions.q: In the advertisement, the phrase "marked down" is closest in meaning to
questions.why: 「値下げされている」という意味で、lowered in price に最も近い。

questions.q: How much did the customer save through the loyalty discount?
questions.why: 割引は小計の10%で、請求書に -$27.60 と記載されている。

questions.q: What is indicated about late payments?
c: A fee will be added after the due date.
They will be refused by the shop.
They require approval from the owner.
They are charged the delivery fee again.
questions.why: 支払期限を過ぎた未払い残高には、2%の遅延料が加算される。

questions.q: How many brochures did the clinic order?
questions.why: パンフレットは100部入りのパックを6つ注文したので、合計600部になる。

questions.q: What is indicated about the forklift certificate?
c: It must be earned before applying.
The successful candidate may obtain it after being hired.
It is not needed for the job.
It is paid for by an outside agency.
questions.why: 適任者には採用後1か月以内に研修を受けさせられるとあり、入社後に取得できることがわかる。

questions.q: What is NOT listed as a responsibility of the supervisor?
questions.why: 採用活動は職務として挙げられていない。他は職務内容に書かれている。

questions.q: What must applicants send?
c: A cover letter and a certificate
questions.why: 応募には履歴書と推薦者2名の情報を送ると書かれている。

questions.q: Why was the letter written?
c: To explain the city's plan for a tree
To reply to a complaint about parking
To ask for permission to enter a property
questions.why: Eklund さんの手紙への返答として、木の撤去予定を知らせている。

questions.q: What is Mr. Eklund asked to do before the work begins?
c: Move his vehicle off the street
Attend a meeting at the office
questions.why: 作業前夜までに、通りに停めた車を移動するよう求められている。

questions.q: What is implied about Mr. Eklund's October 20 letter?
c: It asked for a parking permit.
It offered to plant a new tree.
It concerned the condition of a tree.
It was written by an arborist.
questions.why: 返信の冒頭から、10月20日の手紙は家の外の大きな木についてのものだとわかる。

questions.q: What is indicated about the route planning workshop?
c: It is open to all attendees.
It will be held in Ballroom A.
It begins after the closing remarks.
Participants must sign up in advance.
questions.why: 参加者は30名に限定され、登録デスクで申し込む必要がある。

questions.q: What is true about the prize drawing?
c: Winners must be at the event.
It is open only to speakers.
questions.why: 閉会時に行われ、当選するには会場にいなければならない。

questions.q: How long is the lunch break?
questions.why: 昼食は12時から1時30分までなので、90分間である。

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
c: A plan to raise the prices of washing machines
The opening of a facility for repairing and recycling appliances
The retirement of a company president
A new line of energy-saving products
questions.why: 修理とリサイクルの施設の開設を伝える記事である。

questions.q: What will happen to appliances that cannot be fixed?
c: They will be sold at reduced prices.
They will be returned to customers.
Usable metals will be taken from them.
They will be sent to a northern center.
questions.why: 修理できない製品からは、使える金属が取り出される。

questions.q: Who can receive a coupon?
c: Anyone who attended the opening ceremony
Customers who buy a refurbished product
A person who brings in an old appliance from any brand
questions.why: ブランドを問わず古い家電を持ち込めば、新品用のクーポンがもらえる。

questions.q: Why did Mr. Sorensen write the e-mail?
c: To change the details of a dinner order
questions.why: 人数とメニューの変更を知らせる内容である。

questions.q: How many more guests are expected than originally planned?
questions.why: 当初の120人から148人に増えたので、28人増である。

questions.q: What is NOT requested in the e-mail?
c: A change of the event date
questions.why: 日程の変更は依頼されていない。他は本文で依頼されている。

questions.q: Why does Mr. Sorensen want to replace the dessert?
c: Some guests are allergic to nuts.
questions.why: ナッツアレルギーの出席者がいて、ケーキにはナッツが含まれているためである。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
c: To report a change in work hours
To request a new parking fee
questions.why: 駐車場の改修に伴う一時的な制限を知らせるメモである。

questions.q: Where can an employee who usually parks in the north half park on January 27?
c: On Dunmore Street for a fee
questions.why: 1月27日は北側が閉鎖されるので、開いている南側などを使うことになる。

questions.q: What must employees do to enter the drawing?
c: Show a staff ID each morning
Commute without driving alone on all five days
Park only in the south half
questions.why: 相乗りまたは公共交通機関を5日間すべてで利用し、1月23日までに登録する必要がある。

questions.q: What is NOT stated about the Dunmore Street lot?
c: It is free for staff in this period.
Staff must show an ID there.
questions.why: 屋根付きの駐車スペースについては書かれていない。

questions.q: Why did Ms. Rahimi write the e-mail?
c: To cancel her registration for the term
To complain about a class schedule
To apply for a teaching position
To ask about changing her course
questions.why: 登録済みのフランス語の講座を別の講座に変更したいという相談である。

questions.q: How much did Ms. Rahimi most likely pay for her French course?
questions.why: 12月19日までに登録したので10%の早期割引が適用され、260ドルの9割で234ドルになる。

questions.q: According to the Web page, why might Ms. Rahimi be charged for switching?
c: She has passed the first week of classes.
She is choosing a more expensive course.
She has not bought a textbook.
questions.why: 最初の1週間を過ぎると、変更に30ドルの手数料がかかる。

questions.q: What does Ms. Rahimi ask about Business English?
c: Whether the class is held on weekends
Whether she can buy the textbook at the office
questions.why: メールの最後で、テキストを事務所で購入できるか尋ねている。

questions.q: On which day will Ms. Rahimi most likely attend class if her request is approved?
questions.why: ビジネス英語を希望しており、その曜日は火曜日である。

questions.q: According to the article, how will the program be paid for?
c: By a new tax on residents
By a donation from the university
By the sale of the city's bicycles
questions.why: 運営会社が運賃と駅の広告収入の見返りに全費用を負担する。

questions.q: How much would a 10-minute ride cost a person without a monthly pass?
questions.why: 解錠料1ドルに、1分15セント×10分の1.50ドルを加えて2.50ドルになる。

questions.q: Why did Ms. Lowell write the letter?
c: To express concern about where stations will be placed
To object to the cost of the program
To apply for a job with Velo Link
To report an accident involving a bicycle
questions.why: 計画自体には賛成だが、駅の配置が偏ることへの懸念を述べている。

questions.q: What is suggested about Ms. Lowell?
c: She does not live near the first stations.
She is a member of the city council.
questions.why: 最初の駅が中心部に集まるため、Eastfield の住民は不便になると述べている。

questions.q: What does Ms. Lowell ask for that the article does not provide?
c: A list of monthly pass prices
The names of the other companies
A timeline for stations in outer areas
questions.why: 周辺地域に駅が広がる時期の予定を示すよう求めている。

questions.q: What is included in the price of every class?
c: A private lesson with the chef
questions.why: 広告に、全講座に食材とレシピ冊子が含まれると書かれている。

questions.q: At what time did the Handmade Pasta class most likely end?
questions.why: 広告では午後9時終了で、レビューでは30分延びたとあるので、午後9時30分である。

questions.q: What will Sunridge do about the room temperature?
c: Offer a refund to all students
questions.why: メールで、来月に換気扇を追加で設置すると述べられている。

questions.q: What is a condition of the credit?
c: It is valid only for the Handmade Pasta class.
It must be used for a class booked before the end of the year.
It can be combined with gift certificates.
It must be redeemed in person.
questions.why: 12月31日までに予約する講座に使え、ギフト券とは併用できない。

questions.q: How much would Mr. Aldous pay for the Seasonal Soups class if he uses the credit?
questions.why: スープ講座は50ドルで、20ドルのクレジットを使うと30ドルになる。

questions.q: Why did Mr. Delacroix write the first e-mail?
c: To announce a new office location
To report that a desk was damaged
To ask for a decision about how many desks to buy
questions.why: デスクの購入台数について、どちらにするか判断を求めている。

questions.q: What is indicated about the Model 300?
c: It is operated by a hand crank.
Its frame warranty lasts one year.
It has the widest desktop of the three models.
questions.why: 天板は160cmで、3機種の中で最も幅が広い。

questions.q: How much would eight Model 300 desks cost, including delivery and assembly?
questions.why: 610ドル×8台で4,880ドル、10台未満なので1台40ドルの配送・組立で320ドルを加え、5,200ドルになる。

questions.q: Why does Ms. Pruett decide against buying two extra desks?
c: The total would exceed the budget.
The model is out of stock.
The new hires will not need desks.
questions.why: 10台にすると割引後も5,795ドルとなり、予算の5,500ドルを超える。

questions.q: What will Mr. Delacroix most likely do next?
c: Order ten desks to receive a discount
Order eight Model 300 desks from Ordway
Ask the team to choose a different model
questions.why: 返信で8台のままにして、今週中に注文するよう指示されている。

questions.q: What is the purpose of Ms. Moritz's e-mail?
c: To announce a new shuttle route
To ask staff to select a workshop session
questions.why: 2つのセッションのどちらに出るか、5月13日までに返信するよう求めている。

questions.q: At what time does the Q&A with senior account managers begin in the afternoon session?
questions.why: 午後の部は午後1時30分開始で、質疑応答は開始から2時間45分後の午後4時15分になる。

questions.q: What will Ms. Foss most likely do?
c: Attend the morning session by car
Attend the afternoon session using the shuttle
questions.why: 午前11時の電話があるため午後の部に出て、12時45分のシャトルを使うと考えられる。

questions.q: At 9:23 A.M., why does Mr. Voight write, "It's May 13, right?"
c: To ask about the shuttle schedule
questions.why: Foss さんがメールを送ると言ったのを受けて、返信の期限を確認している。

questions.q: What is NOT stated about the workshop?
c: Both sessions use the same program.
It will be held at headquarters.
Each session has a limited number of seats.
questions.why: 会場は Eastgate Conference Center で、本社ではない。

docs.label: Article
docs.text:
Crumb & Co. to Open Second Location

HARBORTON (August 19) — Crumb & Co., a bakery popular among local residents, announced that it will open a second store in the Riverside district next month. Owner Dalia Brenner said the new shop will (1) a wider selection of breads and pastries than the original store. (2) The Riverside store will employ twelve people, (3) of whom will be recruited from the neighborhood. “We have received so much support from the community, (4) we wanted to give something back,” Ms. Brenner said.

docs.label: Text-message chain
docs.text:
Corinne Walsh [10:02 A.M.]: Marcus, the caterer just called. The sandwiches for tomorrow's client luncheon won't be ready until 1:00 P.M.
Marcus Boyd [10:04 A.M.]: That's an hour after our guests arrive. Did they say why?
Corinne Walsh [10:05 A.M.]: Their delivery van is being repaired. They offered a 15 percent discount or a free dessert tray.
Marcus Boyd [10:07 A.M.]: Hmm. I'd rather not risk it. Is there another option?
Corinne Walsh [10:08 A.M.]: Dolores Cafe can do it, but they need our order by noon today.
Marcus Boyd [10:09 A.M.]: Then let's go with them. Can you place the order? I'll tell the caterer we're canceling.
Corinne Walsh [10:10 A.M.]: Sure. I'll handle it now.

docs.text:

Kestrel Appliances Opens Repair Center

BELLMONT (June 12) — Kestrel Appliances, one of the region's largest makers of household appliances, opened a repair and recycling center on Thursday in the Bellmont Industrial Park. The 4,000-square-meter facility will refurbish returned products for resale at reduced prices and extract usable metals from items that cannot be fixed. "Customers have asked us for years what happens to their old washing machines," said company president Hanna Osei at the opening ceremony. "Now we can give them a clear answer." The center is expected to create 85 jobs over the next two years. Kestrel also announced that customers who bring in an old appliance of any brand will receive a 10 percent coupon toward a new Kestrel product. Ms. Osei said the company hopes to open a second center in the northern region by 2028.

docs.text:
City Council Approves Bike-Share Program

DORCHELL (April 3) — The Dorchell City Council voted 7–2 on Tuesday to launch a bike-share program that will place 300 bicycles at 30 stations across the city by September. The program will be run by Velo Link, a private company that won the contract over two competitors. Users will rent a bicycle through a mobile app for $1 to unlock it and 15 cents per minute thereafter. Monthly passes costing $20 will allow unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes each. Councilmember Raul Teague, who voted against the plan, said the money would be better spent repairing roads. Supporters argued that the program would reduce downtown traffic and cost taxpayers nothing, as Velo Link will cover all expenses in exchange for revenue from fares and advertising on the stations. The first ten stations will open in June around the central station, the university, and Riverside Park.

docs.label: Letter to the editor
docs.text:
To the Editor:

I am writing in response to your April 3 article on the new bike-share program. As a commuter who rides to work every day, I welcome the council's decision. However, I am concerned that the first stations will be concentrated near the central station, the university, and the park, leaving residents of the Eastfield neighborhood, where I live, without convenient access. The article notes that the first ten stations will open in June, but it does not say when stations will reach outer areas. I urge the council to publish a clear schedule. I also hope Velo Link will keep its monthly pass affordable for students.

Sincerely,
Marguerite Lowell
Eastfield
